profile.capacity_note: not published per-building; Equinix's own page provides no capacity or investment figures
profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 40 (Equinix missing-address campaign): added a six source agreeing aggregator address that resolves a prior sessions not found on the operators index page concern, research_status remains complete.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Equinix operates a very large global portfolio and this session found its own per-building pages under equinix.com/data-centers/ to be inconsistently populated: some individual IBX codes 404 entirely (confirmed fresh this session for DC17), and others that do load, such as DC7, checked fresh this session, still omit street address and square footage, deferring that detail to a downloadable specification sheet not reachable by this research pass. Given this, addresses in this batch rely on aggregator sourcing, preferring cases with independent multi source agreement, per this registrys standard source hierarchy. This specific row, SV17, on the Santa Clara/San Jose Silicon Valley metro campus. A prior research pass found SV17 absent from the Silicon Valley metro index pages visible list of building codes and flagged it as possibly renamed, retired, or not yet public. This session found that concern was likely just an index page gap: SV17 is independently and consistently documented at 3030 Corvin Drive, Santa Clara, CA by multiple aggregators, including DataCenterMap, Baxtel, datacenterHawk equivalent sources Inflect and datacenters.com, DataCenterJournal, and PeeringDBs own facility registry, six agreeing sources, indicating the facility is real and active even though this sessions check of the operators own metro index page still did not surface it in the visible list.
sources_tried: Equinix own Silicon Valley metro index page, DataCenterMap, Baxtel, Inflect, and PeeringDB listings all specific to this building and agreeing on its address
profile.regional_context: Per Equinix's own site, the Silicon Valley metro comprises 12 facilities (SV1-SV5, SV8, SV10-SV12x, SV14-SV16) described as the region's largest retail colocation footprint, serving over 10,500 customers including 4,900+ enterprises and 2,000+ network service providers.
profile.facility_type_note: Part of Equinix's Silicon Valley campus, spanning Santa Clara, San Jose (including the Great Oaks campus), Palo Alto, Sunnyvale, with a separate facility in Torrance in the Los Angeles area also grouped in this state.
